name: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF
definition: A diffusion-based method for editing a NeRF scene guided by text instructions, utilizing InstructPix2Pix [9].
summary: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF edits NeRF scenes via text-guided 2D image diffusion and iterative retraining, distinguishing itself by avoiding explicit 3D deformation fields.
